These matters were called on for hearing today.

Coram :
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Karol
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Satish Chandra Sharma
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Swastik Dalai, AOR
For Respondent(s) :

Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R T.P.(Crl.) No(s).487/2025:
1.

By way of this Transfer Petition, the petitioners seek transfer of proceedings C.G.R.
No.2327 of 2023, titled State vs. Akash Dubey & Ors., pending before the Court of the learned Judicial Magistrate, Alipore District-South 24 Paragnas, West Bengal to the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jamshedpur, East Singhbhum District, Jharkhand.

The grounds raised by the petitioners for transfer are: petitioners are at the apprehension of threat to their life; petitioners cannot travel over a long distance of more than 300 Kms; and the petitioners have not committed any offence under Section 498A read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Issue notice, returnable on 02.09.2025.
4.
Dasti service, in addition, is permitted.
Let steps for service be taken within two weeks.
5. In the notice itself let it be mentioned that the respondents are required to file the counter affidavit before the next date of listing.
